# Documentation Excellence v4.6 R2 — Screenshot Intelligence

Screenshot Intelligence adds deterministic metadata-based screenshot selection
before document planning. Existing Reviews and recordings need no migration, and
missing or equivalent metadata preserves the previous result.

Manual choices and annotations take precedence. Original screenshot and
annotation data remain immutable. Document Workspace and Word receive the same
selected screenshot from one validated Document Plan.

No AI, OCR, computer vision, pixel analysis or external service was introduced.
The implementation is technically production-ready, but no persisted real Review
was available for the required before-and-after assessment. Demonstrated
user-visible improvement on real data is therefore not claimed. R1's separate
visible-output verification item remains unresolved.
